title: 🔆🔅The second wave of IRGC's missile launches in Operation Nasr 2
text:
🔆🔅The second wave of IRGC's missile launches in Operation Nasr 2"

"In this wave, Fattah and Kheybar Shekan missiles were fired against radars and targets of the terrorist U.S. Army in Jordan, and Fateh-110 and Zolfaghar missiles were launched against other American targets in the region."

""

"On the missiles, in order:"

"A Persian inscription reads: "We will fly toward the battlefield.""
"— Attributed to: "Martyr Leader, Imam Khamenei.""

"On another missile, an inscription in Arabic reads: "Leader of the Islamic Revolution.""

"The messages are addressed to the Arab neighbors along the shores of the eternal Persian Gulf:"

""I say to Iran's southern neighbors: We are still awaiting an appropriate response from you, so that we may demonstrate our brotherhood and goodwill to you. However, this will only be realized if you turn away from the arrogant and the haughty.
